summary: FIX-14 verification (May 22 audit): the 10 /dashboard/admin/* alias routes added in App.js (lines 121-132) all render the AdminLayout with sidebar + main content as expected. All 18 admin routes tested (10 alias + 8 legacy /admin/*) returned OK with no RouteErrorBoundary triggered. Sidebar nav clicks work. Non-admin regression routes (/, /login, /buscar, /categoria/cleaning, /verificar-correo, /instalar) all load cleanly. Zero pageerrors during the run.

issues: All sidebar hrefs point to /admin/* (not /dashboard/admin/*). When a user lands on /dashboard/admin/queue and clicks any sidebar link, URL switches back to /admin/* prefix. Functionally fine (both prefixes render identical pages) but breaks the URL convention if /dashboard/admin/* is meant to be the canonical path. Consider either: (a) making sidebar links prefix-aware, or (b) accepting /admin/* as canonical and treating /dashboard/admin/* purely as deep-link aliases (current behavior).

critical_code_review_comments: App.js routing block is verbose (10 alias Route entries duplicated). Could be DRYed up by mapping an array of [path, Component] pairs, but acceptable as-is for now (clarity > brevity for ~10 lines).

Sidebar nav in AdminLayout hardcodes /admin/* hrefs — if /dashboard/admin/* becomes canonical later, sidebar needs to use relative paths or react-router useResolvedPath() to stay on the active prefix.
RouteErrorBoundary wraps AppRouter at the top — confirmed working: none of the 16 admin routes triggered it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: FIX-14 (May 22 audit) is verified shipped. All 10 /dashboard/admin/* aliases render correctly with sidebar+content, zero error boundaries, zero pageerrors. Sidebar links still target the /admin/* prefix — this is the only nit, flagged as a design note (not a bug). Non-admin regression pages all clean.
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — feature verification, no bug. Original bug (blank /dashboard/admin/* pages) was caused by missing Route entries; main agent added 10 alias Route declarations in App.js (lines 123-132) which correctly map each /dashboard/admin/* path to its existing Admin component. Verified by Playwright that each route returns 531-9866 chars of content, sidebar present, no RouteErrorBoundary fallback.
